doc.title: Dave Brubeck — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Electric keyboards
summary: He used a Baldwin electric piano once on Gates of Justice; his sons use synthesizers.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: You played a little bit, I think, of Fender Rhodes electric piano. Never extensively, but dabbled with it. What was your reaction when these electric keyboards came into use?

It might have been early in this whole business. I had a Baldwin electric piano. I had written a piece that was recorded on Decca, where it needed a kind of organ sound for one sound. I brought along that one keyboard and pressed the “organ” button. Do you remember that?
So that’s the only time. But my sons have used synthesizers and electric keyboards.
